hypothesis: Same-time-of-day return continuation (Heston, Korajczyk & Sadka 2010): the return of a UTC hour on recent days predicts the same hour today on BTC and ETH, from periodic institutional trading and liquidity cycles; following it beats side-matched random twins on both assets.
closed_ideas_check: Not on CLOSED_IDEAS or in batches 1-2 (no same-slot periodicity family). Previous-hour momentum is used only as a report-only control (K3 taker-flow continuation is a 1h flow signal, not a price-periodicity one).
data_choice: binance um klines-1m only; train block 2020-01 -> 2024-06.

rules.decision: every 1m bar s whose close is a UTC hour boundary ((t+60) % 3600 == 0); the coming hour starts at H = t[s] + 60; entry at s+1.
rules.mu: for d = 1..N: the past same hour's return = ln(c[bar t == t[s] - d*86400 + 3600] / c[bar t == t[s] - d*86400]); valid only if both bars exist and are not stale; mu = mean of valid values, needing >= ceil(0.8 N) valid.
rules.signal: side = sign(mu); no trade if mu == 0 or s stale. series='prev_hour' (report-only control): side = sign(ln c[s] / c[bar t == t[s] - 3600]) on the same hours.
rules.bracket: stop = target = stop_pct (1.5) % of c[s]; time exit hold_s = 3540 s after entry (through the hh:58 bar); one trade at a time (engine).

count_check: signals only, count-only train look; configs under 200 non-overlapping on BTC or ETH dropped, not replaced.
expected_sign: positive mean net R on BTC and ETH; N = 30 not weaker than N = 1.
against_the_mechanism: Report only (not gated, not in the budget): previous-hour control (series='prev_hour'), same bracket and exit. If it does as well (mean net R within 0.02R or better), this is plain 1h momentum, not periodicity.
Report per-UTC-hour mean net R from the gated run's trade files; if the effect sits only in the hours starting 00/08/16 UTC (funding prints), it is a funding-flow effect.
The inherited train gate failing for all N.
known_artifact: Decisions on bars closing exactly at a truncation cut have no entry bar in the truncated data (seen in H3), so the truncation-invariance check will report one mismatch per cut. Reported as is; if it were ever the only failing gate check, it goes to Waiting for Sunny, never overridden here.
costs_note: inherited MFP perp costs; 1.5% -> ~0.05R; most trades will be time exits (hourly sd ~0.5-0.8%).
